description:
## Goal Build the TodoList example app in examples/todo/. This is the simplest possible real Filament app: no GenServers, no observables, just the component tree and hooks. It establishes the project structure pattern followed by G2, G3, and G4. Validates: defcomponent, typed props, use_state, event closures (on_click, on_submit), keyed list rendering, closure-passed callbacks. ## Deviation policy Any deviation from this spec requires prior approval. Stop work, run `bw comment "..."` describing the conflict, reopen the ticket, and await guidance. Do not improvise. --- ## 0. Prerequisites — read Track B and C implementation first Before writing any code, read the Track B (flm-t8j) and Track C (flm-oue) implementations to understand the exact API: - defcomponent macro syntax (how to define a component module) - prop macro (supported types, required/default opts) - use_state/2 return shape (does it return {value, setter} tuple or something else?) - ~F sigil template syntax (is it ~F""" or ~F"...", how are expressions interpolated) - How event closures are attached in ~F templates (on_click={fn -> ... end} or other) - How components are nested (just as tags: <.TodoItem item={@item} />?) The code below uses assumed-reasonable syntax. Adjust to match Track B/C's actual API. If the real API differs significantly from what's shown, stop and comment on this ticket. --- ## 1. Project structure Create the following directory tree under filament/examples/todo/: examples/todo/ mix.exs config/ config.exs lib/ todo/ item.ex store.ex todo_web/ components/ todo_item.ex todo_list.ex live/ todo_live.ex endpoint.ex router.ex Also modify filament/mix.exs (see section 2). --- ## 2. filament/mix.exs — elixirc_paths change Find the existing `elixirc_paths/1` function (it is likely `defp elixirc_paths(:test), do: [...]` or a pattern-matched function). If it does not exist, add it. Goal: in the :test env, include examples/todo/lib so that test code can import TodoWeb.Components.* and Todo.* modules without a circular Mix dep. ```elixir # In filament/mix.exs, update or add: defp elixirc_paths(:test) do [ "lib", "test/support", "examples/todo/lib" # G2 will add: "examples/cart/lib" # G3 will add: "examples/inventory/lib" # G4 will add: "examples/collaboration/lib" ] end defp elixirc_paths(_), do: ["lib"] ``` IMPORTANT: Do NOT add {:todo, path: "examples/todo"} to deps. That creates a circular dependency (todo/mix.exs depends on filament, filament/mix.exs would depend on todo). elixirc_paths is the correct mechanism here. --- ## 3. examples/todo/mix.exs This is a standalone Mix project. When run directly (cd examples/todo && mix phx.server), it should work as a real Phoenix app. It depends on filament via relative path. ```elixir defmodule Todo.MixProject do use Mix.Project def project do [ app: :todo, version: "0.1.0", elixir: "~> 1.15", elixirc_paths: elixirc_paths(Mix.env()), start_permanent: Mix.env() == :prod, deps: deps() ] end def application do [ mod: {Todo.Application, []}, extra_applications: [:logger] ] end defp elixirc_paths(:test), do: ["lib", "test/support"] defp elixirc_paths(_), do: ["lib"] defp deps do [ {:phoenix, "~> 1.7"}, {:phoenix_live_view, "~> 0.20"}, {:filament, path: "../../"}, {:jason, "~> 1.4"} ] end end ``` Check existing Phoenix and LiveView version constraints already used in filament/mix.exs and mirror them here to avoid version conflicts. --- ## 4. examples/todo/config/config.exs Minimal configuration needed for standalone operation. Copy from a standard Phoenix generator output or adapt from another app in the repo. At minimum: ```elixir import Config config :todo, TodoWeb.Endpoint, url: [host: "localhost"], render_errors: [formats: [html: TodoWeb.ErrorHTML], layout: false], pubsub_server: Todo.PubSub, live_view: [signing_secret: "todo-signing-secret-dev-only"] config :logger, :console, format: "$time $metadata[$level] $message\n", metadata: [:request_id] ``` This is only for standalone operation; tests do not use this config. --- ## 5. examples/todo/lib/todo/item.ex ```elixir defmodule Todo.Item do @enforce_keys [:id, :text] defstruct [:id, :text, done: false] @type t :: %__MODULE__{ id: pos_integer(), text: String.t(), done: boolean() } end ``` --- ## 6. examples/todo/lib/todo/store.ex A plain Agent holding the todo list. Start it under a name for production use; pass the name/pid explicitly in tests (for isolation — no shared global state in tests). ```elixir defmodule Todo.Store do use Agent @doc """ Start a Todo.Store. Pass `name: __MODULE__` for the production singleton, or omit (or pass a unique name) for test isolation. """ def start_link(opts \\ []) do name = Keyword.get(opts, :name, __MODULE__) Agent.start_link(fn -> {1, []} end, name: name) end @doc "Return all items in insertion order." def all(store \\ __MODULE__) do Agent.get(store, fn {_next, items} -> items end) end @doc "Add a new item with the given text. Returns :ok." def add(store \\ __MODULE__, text) when is_binary(text) and text != "" do Agent.update(store, fn {next, items} -> item = %Todo.Item{id: next, text: text} {next + 1, items ++ [item]} end) end @doc "Toggle the done flag for the item with the given id." def toggle(store \\ __MODULE__, id) when is_integer(id) do Agent.update(store, fn {next, items} -> updated = Enum.map(items, fn %{id: ^id} = item -> %{item | done: !item.done} item -> item end) {next, updated} end) end @doc "Filter by :all | :active | :completed." def filter(store \\ __MODULE__, :all), do: all(store) def filter(store \\ __MODULE__, :active), do: Enum.reject(all(store), & &1.done) def filter(store \\ __MODULE__, :completed), do: Enum.filter(all(store), & &1.done) end ``` --- ## 7. examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_item.ex Stateless component. Receives item and on_toggle callback as props. Read Track B/C implementation to confirm the exact defcomponent / prop / ~F syntax before writing. The pseudocode below uses assumed API — adjust if needed: ```elixir defmodule TodoWeb.Components.TodoItem do # Track B delivers the component macro. Check lib/filament/component.ex for exact API. use Filament.Component # Props — check prop macro signature in Track B. Typical shape: # prop :name, :type, required: true | default: value prop :item, :any, required: true # expects %Todo.Item{} prop :on_toggle, :fun, required: true # Check whether Track B uses render/1 or a def inside defcomponent. def render(assigns) do ~F"""
    • """ end end ``` Key design points: - id={"todo-item-#{@item.id}"} enables keyed list rendering (Track B/C reconciler uses the id attribute for stable identity across renders). - on_click={@on_toggle} passes the closure through to Track E3's event dispatch. The closure receives no arguments (or a click event map — check E3's on_click contract). - No state in this component. All state lives in TodoList. --- ## 8. examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_list.ex Parent component managing filter and new-item text with use_state. ```elixir defmodule TodoWeb.Components.TodoList do use Filament.Component # store is passed as a prop so tests can inject an isolated Todo.Store pid. # In production, defaults to Todo.Store (the named singleton). prop :store, :any, default: Todo.Store def render(assigns) do # use_state returns {current_value, setter_fn} — confirm with Track B/C. {filter, set_filter} = use_state(:filter, :all) {new_text, set_new_text} = use_state(:new_text, "") items = Todo.Store.filter(assigns.store, filter) ~F"""
    text} -> Todo.Store.add(@store, text) set_new_text.("") end}>
      <%= for item <- items do %> <.TodoItem item={item} on_toggle={fn -> Todo.Store.toggle(@store, item.id) end} /> <% end %>
    """ end end ``` Notes for the agent: - The `<.TodoItem ...>` syntax (dot-prefix for local component) may differ in Track B. Check how Track B renders a child component from a ~F template. - `on_submit` closure receives form params as a map. The map keys match input `name` attrs. Confirm the params shape with Track E3's on_submit contract. - `use_state/2` — check exact return shape. If Track B returns {value, setter} where setter is a 1-arity function, the above is correct. If the setter is a 2-arity `set_state(key, value)` call, adjust accordingly. - The for-comprehension keying relies on the `id` attribute set in TodoItem. - `@store` inside the closure captures the assigns at render time. Verify that closures have access to assigns via @ shorthand or whether assigns must be bound explicitly. --- ## 9. examples/todo/lib/todo_web/live/todo_live.ex The LiveView host that mounts TodoList as a root fiber. ```elixir defmodule TodoWeb.TodoLive do use Phoenix.LiveView # Filament.LiveView injects handle_info, handle_event, etc. # Check Track B/C for the exact macro to use here. use Filament.LiveView @impl true def mount(_params, _session, socket) do # Start an isolated store for this connection. {:ok, store} = Todo.Store.start_link([]) {:ok, assign(socket, store: store)} end @impl true def render(assigns) do # mount_fiber/2 or similar from Track B/C mounts TodoList as the root fiber. # Check Track B for the exact call. Typical shape: ~H"""
    <%= Filament.mount_component(TodoWeb.Components.TodoList, store: @store) %>
    """ end end ``` NOTE: The exact API for mounting a Filament component inside a LiveView render is the core of Track B. Read lib/filament/live_view.ex (Track B output) before writing this file. Do not guess — the wrong API here will compile but silently produce no output. --- ## 10. Minimal router and endpoint (standalone only) FILE: examples/todo/lib/todo_web/router.ex ```elixir defmodule TodoWeb.Router do use Phoenix.Router import Phoenix.LiveView.Router pipeline :browser do plug :accepts, ["html"] plug :fetch_session plug :put_root_layout, html: {TodoWeb.Layouts, :root} end scope "/", TodoWeb do pipe_through :browser live "/", TodoLive end end ``` FILE: examples/todo/lib/todo_web/endpoint.ex Standard Phoenix.Endpoint module. Generate with mix phx.gen or copy-adapt from another Phoenix app. The exact content is boilerplate — not critical for tests. --- ## 11. Test: verify compilation and module structure FILE: test/filament/examples/todo_compilation_test.exs ```elixir defmodule Filament.Examples.TodoCompilationTest do use ExUnit.Case, async: true # These modules are compiled because mix.exs adds examples/todo/lib to # elixirc_paths(:test). If any is missing, the test file itself won't compile. alias Todo.{Item, Store} alias TodoWeb.Components.{TodoItem, TodoList} test "Todo.Item struct has expected fields" do item = %Item{id: 1, text: "hello"} assert item.id == 1 assert item.text == "hello" assert item.done == false end test "Todo.Store add and filter" do {:ok, store} = Store.start_link([]) Store.add(store, "buy milk") Store.add(store, "write tests") assert length(Store.all(store)) == 2 assert Enum.all?(Store.all(store), &(not &1.done)) Store.toggle(store, 1) assert length(Store.filter(store, :completed)) == 1 assert length(Store.filter(store, :active)) == 1 end test "TodoItem component module exists with expected props" do # Check that the module is compiled and defines expected props. # The exact introspection API depends on Track B. At minimum, verify the # module is loaded. assert Code.ensure_loaded?(TodoItem) end test "TodoList component module exists" do assert Code.ensure_loaded?(TodoList) end end ``` --- ## Completion criteria This ticket is complete when: 1. `mix compile` succeeds from `examples/todo/` (standalone). 2. `mix compile` succeeds from `filament/` with the new elixirc_paths. 3. `mix test test/filament/examples/todo_compilation_test.exs` passes all 4 assertions. 4. No compiler warnings for any example module. If any criterion cannot be met without deviating from this spec, stop and comment.
